data.summary: Beispielkey Lettings GmbH, the letting agency for the tenancy at Quellenweg 7, Beispielwetzlar, charges €240.00 for professional cleaning of the kitchen and bathroom found necessary at the final move-out inspection. Payment is due within 14 days of receiving this letter, and the deposit will only be returned once it has arrived.
data.explanation: The letting agency found the kitchen and bathroom needed professional cleaning after you moved out and had this done at your cost, citing your tenancy agreement. You should pay the €240.00 within the deadline shown, which the app calculates from when you received this letter. If you disagree with the charge (e.g. you believe normal wear and tear doesn't require professional cleaning, or the clause isn't valid), you may want to check your tenancy contract or get advice before paying. Until you pay, the agency says it will not return your deposit.
